source_of_truth.rationale: The Rust server does not yet emit OpenAPI or JSON Schema. Phase 16a uses this curated manifest as the checked-in route/DTO/error contract and validates it against server routes plus existing web helpers. Full schema generation is deferred to Phase 16d.

schema_strategy.current: Curated route manifest plus checked-in JSON fixtures
schema_strategy.next: Add JSON Schema fixtures beside the manifest and make fixture drift fail CI
schema_strategy.future: Generate OpenAPI 3.1 or JSON Schema from Rust server metadata when DTO/schema derivation exists

cache_profiles.private_json: Authenticated JSON; clients must not public-cache and should revalidate on foreground/resume unless a route declares ETag semantics
cache_profiles.private_etag_json: Authenticated JSON with private ETag/If-None-Match support where route implementation exposes it
cache_profiles.private_binary: Authenticated binary or media bytes; clients must not persist signed URLs or bearer-bearing request metadata
cache_profiles.no_store_read: Unauthenticated or authenticated read response that exposes setup/auth state and must not be cached
cache_profiles.no_store_action: Mutation/action response; clients must not cache

pagination_profiles.cursor: limit plus opaque cursor where response exposes next_cursor
pagination_profiles.offset: page/page_size only where existing route documents offset pagination

sse_events.privacy: No tokens, signed URLs, or private paths
No source paths, bearer tokens, or package file paths
Stable item IDs and bounded reason strings only
Session identifiers only; clients clear local credentials immediately
